title: paeonia officinalis subsp. microcarpa
intro: Paeonia officinalis subsp. microcarpa, commonly known as the small-flowered peony, is a plant species belonging to the Paeoniaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia officinalis subsp. microcarpa are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include paeonol, paeoniflorin, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
